text.zh_CN:
钢笔一次只能存放一管钢笔芯，但一管能够书写更久。手持右键打开笔内的替芯槽，把钢笔芯放进去；它会保存在笔中，供现代研究台书写时自动消耗。
笔芯耗尽后会从槽中消失，放入新的笔芯即可继续书写。
text.en_US:
A fountain pen holds only one refill, but it lasts longer. Use the pen in your hand to open its refill slot and place a refill inside. It stays in the pen and is used automatically at the modern research desk.
When the ink runs out, insert a new refill to keep writing.

text.zh_CN:
两块钢锭竖直放在一管钢笔芯上方，可以合成钢笔；新笔内已有一管笔芯。可使用属于钢锭标签的钢锭。
三个墨囊和一桶水无序合成九管钢笔芯，水桶会保留。
text.en_US:
Place two steel ingots vertically above a pen refill to craft a fountain pen. A new pen contains one refill. Any ingot in the steel ingot tag can be used.
Three ink sacs and a water bucket make nine refills in any arrangement; the bucket is returned.
